entries.issuing_body: U.S. Department of the Treasury (Departmental Offices)
entries.title: Treasury seeks comment on renewing the garnishment-notice collection for accounts holding federal benefit payments
entries.facts: On 2026-10-26 the Department of the Treasury's Departmental Offices published a Federal Register notice requesting public comment on an extension of the currently approved information collection "Notice to Account Holder for Garnishment of Accounts Containing Federal Benefit Payments," OMB control number 1505-0230. The collection covers the notice a financial institution must give an account holder under 31 CFR 212.6 when a garnishment order reaches an account receiving directly deposited federal benefit payments, stating that a protected amount has been established and that funds above it are subject to garnishment, and describing the order, the protected amount, any fee charged and the account holder's rights. The burden estimate also covers garnishment recordkeeping under 31 CFR 212.11 and attaching a Notice of Right to Garnish Federal Benefits to certain child support orders. Comments are due on or before 2026-12-28.
entries.source_label: Federal Register, Treasury Departmental Offices notice (OMB 1505-0230), 2026-10-26
entries.relevant_to: banks and credit unions, payment processors, deposit-account operations and compliance teams
